title: Drowned Shrine
author: SwedenJohansson
summary: An island under the sea: corals, sunken barrels and a hoard for divers.
description:
The sea took this island long ago. Dive down among the corals and the sunken barrels - there is loot for those who can hold their breath.
Tick 'Also turn up while sailing' when you download it to meet it by chance in your worlds.
